summary: The internal tags a value can report, as named constants.
description: `objectToString` returns strings like `"[object Array]"`; this enum gives those strings names, so a comparison reads as `ObjectTag.ARRAY` rather than as a literal that a typo can quietly break.
Several guards in the library are built on it — it is how `isRegExp` and `isFunction` recognise a value that crossed a frame boundary, where `instanceof` no longer holds.

examples.title: Shape
examples.body:
```javascript
objectToString([]) === ObjectTag.ARRAY; // => true
objectToString(null) === ObjectTag.NULL; // => true
```
